description: How an airport is running today (airport-local day), with a link to its page on gaduin.com. departures: today's flights on record scheduled in the local day, each counted once, with coverage on_record (the counts cover the flights on record for this airport today, not its full schedule); of those due (scheduled at or before now) each is exactly one of on_time, delayed, cancelled, not_reported (no recorded departure yet) or not_graded (a recorded departure with a null allowance or more than 60 minutes before its schedule); decided = on_time + delayed + cancelled; cancelled_later counts cancellations scheduled after now, and diverted the due flights shown diverted (also counted in their outcome). Delayed means departing more than delay_threshold_minutes plus taxi_allowance_minutes after the scheduled time; the allowance is the airport's usual taxi time where its departure times are take-off times, 0 for gate times, and null when its departures are not graded yet. The on-time, delayed, cancelled and disrupted (delayed + cancelled) shares are over decided; they and the typical delay of the delayed flights (their lower median) are null, and verdict is unknown, below min_decided (20) decided flights or when departures are not graded. arrivals: coverage is airport_list with share_basis scheduled_day (the airport's own arrivals list), else on_record; with share_basis scheduled_day, arrivals scheduled today, landed and cancelled, with cancelled_share = cancelled / scheduled, null below min_scheduled (20); with share_basis not_comparable (US airports), flights landed in the local day and flights scheduled in it and cancelled, two different days, so scheduled and cancelled_share are null and arrivals never rate the airport; arrival delays are not measured. A side GADUIN did not read today is null. status: severe when the departures disrupted share is at least 0.50, disrupted from 0.25, else normal; when departures are not rated, severe or disrupted when the arrivals cancelled share reaches 0.50 or 0.25, else not_rated, or no_data when nothing was read. status_from names the side that set it; disruption_score is the departures disrupted share. observed_utc is the time of the newest recorded departure.

airport.description: Airport IATA code (e.g. LHR) or ICAO code (e.g. EGLL).

name: get_airport_status
title: Airport status today
